description: RUNG 5 — COMPLEX CELLS. A CUnit population that POOLS simple Units, with TEMPORAL SLOWNESS (Foldiak 1991 trace learning) on an Oja-normalised weight update. complex=0 default => byte-identical to every committed result.

attrs.name: default
attrs.comment: RUNG 5 knobs as GRAPH DATA (PROTOCOL 0 — the ablation is the agent's own configuration, never a Python code path). complex: 0.0 (default) = the CUnit rules are inert, so every result committed before rung 5 reproduces byte-identically; 1.0 = the pooling layer runs. trace_delta: the Foldiak trace's update fraction, the MECHANISM knob. 1.0 (default) = trace ≡ cact exactly, i.e. NO temporal memory — the ABLATED arm, plain instantaneous Oja pooling. delta<1 (e.g. 0.2) = the post-synaptic trace averages over ~1/delta steps, which is the SLOWNESS mechanism: a feature that PERSISTS across adjacent moments shares identity, and under a drifting grating PHASE varies fast while ORIENTATION varies slowly, so learning on the trace pools over phase and keeps orientation. WHY A TRACE IS THE MECHANISM: simple cells at the same orientation but different phases are ANTI-correlated at zero lag (when the phase-0 cell is on, the phase-180 cell is off), so an INSTANTANEOUS covariance cannot bind them — only a time-LAGGED one can, and the trace is what makes Oja's attractor the time-smoothed covariance rather than the instantaneous one. cx_eta: the Oja rate on the pooling weights; 5e-4 is the regime measured stable for oja_learn (2e-3 diverges to NaN there). NOTE ON THE RUNG-3 INVERSION: Oja's attractor being the TIME-AVERAGE is what FORBADE direction selectivity (the average of an isotropic distribution has no direction). Averaging over PHASE is precisely what a complex cell IS, so the same property that killed rung 3 should GRANT rung 5. That reasoning is recorded here because it motivated the design; it is NOT what the measurement found (see VISION_RUNG5_PREREG.md OUTCOME — the rung fails one level lower, at the precondition, so the inversion is UNTESTED, not confirmed).

rules.name: cx_activate
rules.comment: STAGE 1 of the pooling fixpoint. cact = SUM over pooled Units of cweight * RECTIFIED pre-unit act. The rectification (IfThenElse act>0) is the physiology: a firing RATE is nonnegative, and it is ALSO what makes pooling able to produce invariance at all — a linear sum of LINEAR simple cells is itself a linear filter and is necessarily phase-MODULATED; only pooling RECTIFIED outputs can be phase-invariant (this is the Hubel-Wiesel/energy-model insight). Guarded on cact_step < step so it fires once per CUnit per step, the same idiom wv_unit_activate uses. Gated on ComplexParams.complex==1 so the whole layer is inert by default.

rules.name: cx_trace
rules.comment: STAGE 2 — THE SLOWNESS MECHANISM (Foldiak 1991). trace <- (1-delta)*trace + delta*cact: a leaky running average of the CUnit's OWN post-synaptic activity. Staged on cact_step==step (stage 1 has run) and guarded by trace_step<step (fires once per step), so it can never race the rule that reads it — the same staged-step-marker idiom oja_learn uses (act_step==step), and the same reason wave_world writes prev_burst in the adapter rather than in a rule. At trace_delta=1.0 this sets trace = cact exactly, which is the ABLATION: no temporal memory at all.

rules.name: cx_learn
rules.comment: STAGE 3 — OJA ON THE TRACE. cweight <- cweight*(1 - eta*trace^2) + eta*trace*x, x = the pooled Unit's RECTIFIED act. This is the SAME contraction oja_learn applies to the simple layer, but the post-synaptic term is the TRACE rather than the instantaneous drive, so the fixed point is the leading principal component of the TIME-SMOOTHED input covariance instead of the instantaneous one. That is the entire hypothesis: same-orientation different-phase simple cells are anti-correlated at zero lag but positively correlated within a trace window, so the traced covariance binds them and the instantaneous one cannot. Staged on trace_step==step and guarded by ctouched<step (once per synapse per step).
